correctness.rationale: Walsh orthogonality recovers C(t,a). A star supports nonzero correlations only for a=0, weight1 or weight2 and isolates exactly the local real inner products. For even n, convolution (I+A) on diagonals has all eigenvalues n+1-2w nonzero, so each |f(x)|^2 is recovered. Independence of diagonal and distance-one/two entries gives the stated complex-linear span of real rank-one symmetric projectors. Nonzero 2x2 Gram determinants across predecessor distance-two pairs give real R2 two-neighbor lateration, forcing a common O(2) map even for arbitrary competing h. At n=2 all Gram entries are recovered unconditionally. Two-site signals supported at Hamming distance three have undetectable relative phase for n>=4. Independent exact Walsh combinatorics gives ranks 10,96,736 for n=2,4,6 and the stated cube lateration argument is general, not an extrapolation.
